phase: Phase 4 - Tenant Isolation, Resource ACL & Assistant Security

environment.database: SQLite (aiosqlite) unit test suite + schema isolation; Live Postgres/Qdrant NOT RUN due to <2GB RAM constraint

threat_scenarios.description: Authenticated User A requests User B's resource by UUID
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Target resource UUID with legitimate Tenant B authorization header and X-Tenant-ID
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found (resource does not exist in Tenant B context, zero metadata leaked)

threat_scenarios.description: Tenant A user changes X-Tenant-ID to Tenant B
threat_scenarios.entry_point: All protected API endpoints (FastAPI dependency: get_current_tenant_context)
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Authorization: Bearer <token_a_owner>, X-Tenant-ID: <tenant_b_id>
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 403 Forbidden ('Access denied: You do not have active membership in this workspace')

threat_scenarios.description: Tenant A user submits a valid Tenant B document ID
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Valid doc_b_id with Tenant A X-Tenant-ID header
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found in active workspace

threat_scenarios.description: Tenant A user submits a valid Tenant B knowledge-base ID
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Valid kb_b_id with Tenant A X-Tenant-ID header
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found in active workspace

threat_scenarios.description: Tenant A user submits a valid Tenant B assistant ID
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Valid asst_b_id with Tenant A X-Tenant-ID header
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found in active workspace

threat_scenarios.description: Tenant A user submits a valid Tenant B conversation ID
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Valid conv_b_id with Tenant A X-Tenant-ID header
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found

threat_scenarios.description: Tenant A user requests a message belonging to another tenant
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Valid Tenant B conversation UUID containing messages
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found

threat_scenarios.description: Tenant A user requests a citation belonging to another tenant
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Targeting conversation containing citations from Tenant B docs
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found (parent conversation inaccessible; citations protected)

threat_scenarios.description: Tenant A user requests a document preview from another tenant
threat_scenarios.attack_input: knowledge_base_ids: [kb_b_id] or document_ids: [doc_b_id]
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found (authorizer rejects foreign KB)

threat_scenarios.description: Tenant A user attempts to access another tenant's ingestion job
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Valid job_b_id with Tenant A X-Tenant-ID header
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found in active workspace

threat_scenarios.description: Tenant A user attempts to access another tenant's document version
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Valid doc_b_id with Tenant A X-Tenant-ID header
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found in active workspace

threat_scenarios.description: Tenant A user attempts to manipulate a department or employee-group ID
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Valid dept_b_id with Tenant A X-Tenant-ID header
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found in active workspace

threat_scenarios.description: A user switches workspaces but continues using a resource ID from the previous workspace
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Previous workspace resource ID with new workspace active context header
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found (resource lookup strictly scoped to new active tenant)

threat_scenarios.description: A revoked organization member attempts to reuse an old token
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Valid JWT belonging to user whose membership was marked SUSPENDED
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 403 Forbidden ('Access denied: You do not have active membership in this workspace')

threat_scenarios.description: A user whose role has been downgraded attempts an operation that was previously permitted
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Role updated from org_admin to employee; caller attempts department creation
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 403 Forbidden ('Insufficient permissions: requires department.create')

threat_scenarios.description: A user removes their own membership or loses access during an active workflow
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Tenant owner attempts to delete their own membership
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 400 Bad Request ('Tenant owner cannot remove themselves from their workspace')

threat_scenarios.description: A user attempts to access an assistant whose linked knowledge base is no longer accessible
threat_scenarios.attack_input: KB status changed to INACTIVE or deleted; user streams chat through assistant
threat_scenarios.expected_result: Runtime filters candidate KBs against active KBs belonging to tenant, gracefully proceeding without unauthorized context
threat_scenarios.actual_result: Authorized KBs evaluated dynamically; inactive KBs excluded from retrieval

threat_scenarios.description: A user attempts to retrieve a document after it has been deleted or superseded
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Search query matching chunk whose parent document has status == DELETED
threat_scenarios.expected_result: RetrievalAuthorizer secondary defense strictly strips candidate chunk from response
threat_scenarios.actual_result: Candidate stripped by RetrievalAuthorizer; zero deleted chunks returned

threat_scenarios.description: A user manipulates pagination, search, or filtering parameters to expose other tenants' records
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Boundary pagination parameters on list endpoints
threat_scenarios.expected_result: Only active tenant records returned. Tenant B records never appear in result sets.
threat_scenarios.actual_result: Strictly active tenant records returned. Zero cross-tenant data leaked.

threat_scenarios.description: A user attempts to access protected records through an alternate API endpoint rather than the normal UI
threat_scenarios.attack_input: Direct GET calls bypassing UI state with valid employee bearer token
threat_scenarios.expected_result: 404 Not Found (server-side _check_document_acl denies access)
